title: Find a Pair of Items with Target Rating
real_world_story: A recommendation system assigns numerical scores to items. The system wants to find two different items whose combined score matches a target value.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Sorting followed by a two-pointer search to efficiently locate a pair with the required sum

problem_statement: Given an array of item scores and a target score, find two different scores whose sum equals the target. Print the two values in ascending order. If no such pair exists, print -1.
task: Find a pair of item scores whose sum is exactly equal to the target score.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers representing item scores. The third line contains the target score.
output_format: Print the two values forming the target sum in ascending order. If multiple pairs exist, print the lexicographically smallest pair. If no pair exists, print -1.

examples.explanation: The scores 2 and 8 add up to the target 10.
The scores 3 and 12 add up to 15.

expected_algorithm.name: Two Pointer
expected_algorithm.reason: After sorting the scores, two pointers can efficiently move toward a pair whose sum equals the target. Binary search can also be used for pair lookup.

hint: Start one pointer at the beginning and another at the end.
If the sum is too small, move the left pointer forward.
If the sum is too large, move the right pointer backward.
real_world_takeaway: Two-pointer searching can efficiently identify compatible item combinations when recommendation data can be sorted by score.
